name: Oracle AI Database
description_en:
Oracle’s current database site presents Oracle AI Database, with the26ai release, multiple commercial deployments and a separate Free edition. The platform combines relational data with capabilities such as JSON and vector-related development, but a family overview is not a license or deployment specification for every feature. This record retains the original Oracle Database identity while using current official branding.

This profile focuses on evaluating a26ai Free installation, selecting its intended pluggable-database service and understanding migration and recovery boundaries. It distinguishes the capped Free product from a non-production Enterprise download, managed Autonomous services and commercial options. No installer, server, SQL, account, import or backup was executed.
description_zh:
Oracle 当前数据库官网采用 Oracle AI Database 品牌，介绍26ai版本、多种商业部署及独立 Free 版本。平台结合关系数据和 JSON、向量等开发能力，但家族概述不是所有功能的许可或部署规格。本文保留原 Oracle Database 产品身份，采用当前官网品牌。

本文聚焦26ai Free 安装评估、选择预期可插拔数据库服务，以及迁移／恢复边界，区分有上限的 Free、非生产 Enterprise 下载、托管 Autonomous 服务及商业选件。本次未执行安装、服务器、SQL、账户、导入或备份。

sections.title_en: Free and a free Enterprise download have different rights
sections.title_zh: Free 与免费 Enterprise 下载的权利不同
sections.en: Oracle’s download page says Free can develop, deploy and distribute small applications. The Enterprise download description instead identifies development, prototyping and testing in a non-production environment. Autonomous cloud services and commercial database options are separate choices. Select the actual package, edition, contract and host requirements before evaluating capabilities. Do not infer production entitlement from the absence of a download charge or from a feature being visible in documentation.
sections.zh: 下载页称 Free 可用于小应用开发、部署及分发；Enterprise 下载说明则指定非生产的开发、原型及测试。Autonomous 云服务和商业选件是不同选择。评估能力前需选定具体包、版本类别、合同及主机要求，不能因下载不收费或文档出现某功能就推定生产权利。

sections.title_en: Database limits are not the host’s complete resource budget
sections.title_zh: 数据库限额不是主机完整资源预算
sections.en: The26ai Free page caps database use at two CPUs,2GB RAM and12GB of user data. Those are edition limits, not a statement that the host only needs2GB total RAM or12GB disk. The Linux installation guide separately describes roughly9GB under /opt and specific package/preinstallation requirements. Use a disposable compatible host; the guide requires handling existing XE/Free installations before installation, so it is not a safe instruction to overwrite a populated system. No existing installation was changed.
sections.zh: 26ai Free 页将数据库使用限制为两 CPU、2GB 内存及12GB 用户数据。这是版本限额，不代表主机总内存仅需2GB或磁盘12GB。Linux 安装指南另说明 /opt 约9GB及具体包／预安装要求。应使用兼容可丢弃主机；指南要求安装前处理已有 XE／Free，不是可覆盖有数据系统的安全指令，本次未改已有安装。

sections.title_en: A local SYSDBA session does not prove a PDB client connection
sections.title_zh: 本地 SYSDBA 会话不证明 PDB 客户端连接成功
sections.en: The connection guide distinguishes OS-authenticated SYSDBA access to CDB$ROOT from a network connection through a running listener. Default FREE connects to the root; FREEPDB1 targets the default PDB. An application should verify host, port, service, account and current container instead of treating any successful administrative login as the right database. This cited guide is for Windows; use platform-specific install/authentication instructions elsewhere. No listener, service or account was probed.
sections.zh: 连接指南区分操作系统认证的 CDB$ROOT SYSDBA 访问，以及通过运行中 listener 的网络连接。默认 FREE 连接根容器，FREEPDB1 指向默认 PDB。应用需验证主机、端口、服务、账户及当前容器，不能把管理员登录成功等同接到正确数据库。该引用指南面向 Windows，其他平台需用相应安装／认证说明；本次未探测 listener、服务或账户。

sections.title_en: Free migration is an export/import workflow
sections.title_zh: Free 迁移采用导出／导入流程
sections.en: The Linux migration guide handles21c XE and earlier Free data through Data Pump exports and imports for each PDB. It disallows DBUA upgrades and using DBCA to plug previous-version PDBs into Free;18c XE first moves through21c XE. Review dump directories, privileges, source/target services and logs, and validate objects and row totals before cutover. The guide lists specific expected import messages; that is not permission to ignore unrelated errors. No source was removed or migration run.
sections.zh: Linux 迁移指南按 PDB 用 Data Pump 导出／导入21c XE及较早 Free 数据，不允许 DBUA 升级或用 DBCA 将旧 PDB 插入 Free；18c XE需先迁21c XE。切换前需核导出目录、权限、源／目标服务、日志、对象及行数。指南列举特定预期导入消息，不代表可以忽略其他错误，本次未删除源或运行迁移。

sections.title_zh: 逻辑导出补充物理恢复
sections.en: The backup guide distinguishes physical files—data files, control files and archived redo—from logical objects exported with Data Pump. It calls physical backup the foundation and describes RMAN as the preferred common interface. A migration dump alone is not a full host-loss recovery strategy. Choose the actual edition/options, retention, backup location and restore objective, then rehearse in a separate environment. A capability mentioned in the broad recovery manual is not evidence that every Free installation includes every optional backup service.
sections.zh: 备份指南区分数据文件、控制文件、归档 redo 等物理文件，以及 Data Pump 导出的逻辑对象，将物理备份作为基础、RMAN 作为首选统一接口。迁移导出文件并非完整主机丢失恢复策略。需选定版本／选件、保留期、备份位置及恢复目标，再在独立环境演练。广义恢复手册提到能力，不证明每个 Free 安装包含全部可选备份服务。

sections.title_en: Free Use Terms still impose conditions
sections.title_zh: 免费使用条款仍有条件
sections.en: The linked Free Use Terms permit internal use of unmodified programs for development/testing and internal business operations, plus redistribution without an additional end-user program fee, subject to conditions. They restrict modification/reverse engineering and require notices; separately licensed technology has its own terms. This supports a capped free proprietary product, not an unrestricted open-source grant. Existing Oracle contracts can govern instead. Review the actual distribution/use case; this profile does not assess contractual compliance or quote a paid Enterprise license.
sections.zh: 链接的 Free Use Terms 允许在条件下内部使用未修改程序作开发／测试及内部业务，并可不另向终端用户收程序费地分发；限制修改／逆向、要求声明，独立许可技术另适用条款。这支持有上限的免费专有产品，不是无限开源授权，已有 Oracle 合同也可能优先适用。需按实际分发／用途审查，本文不评估合同合规或提供付费 Enterprise 报价。

sections.title_en: Creating a database does not complete operations
sections.title_zh: 创建数据库不等于运行准备完成
sections.en: The Linux configuration flow creates FREE/FREEPDB1 and administrative accounts, then starts the database and listener. It identifies database files and diagnostic/creation logs, and offers explicit encryption settings rather than proving they were enabled. For a proposed small app, use separate application access, verify the intended PDB and inspect a failed startup’s actual logs. Keep required files, passwords and a restore procedure under the operator’s control. No installation success, security posture or availability result is claimed here.
sections.zh: Linux 配置流程创建 FREE／FREEPDB1 及管理员账户，随后启动库和 listener，列出数据文件、诊断／创建日志及明确加密配置，而不是证明加密已启用。建议小应用使用独立访问、核预期 PDB，并在启动失败时查真实日志。运维方需管理必要文件、密码及恢复流程；本次不声称安装成功、安全或可用性结果。
